full.q: A user runs `list` with `--tag` given twice, with two different tags. Which tasks are shown?

options.B: Tasks that have at least one of the tags

full.why: brief: 'the things that have both, not either'

full.q: How are upper-case and lower-case letters in tags treated?

options.A: A tag with upper-case letters is rejected as an error
options.B: Case is ignored; tags are stored and shown in lower case
options.C: Tags are case-sensitive: Home and home are different tags
options.D: Case is ignored when filtering, but tags are stored exactly as typed

full.why: brief: 'Home and home are the same thing, just store them lowercase'

full.q: A user runs `add` with a tag that contains a space or a `#`. What happens?

options.A: An error is reported but the task is still saved without tags
options.B: The bad characters are removed and the task is saved
options.C: An error with exit code 1, and the task is not saved
options.D: The task is saved without that tag and a warning is printed

full.why: brief: 'that's an error ... exit 1 ... the task doesn't get saved'

full.q: Which characters may a tag contain?
Which tasks does the `tags` command count?

options.C: The user chooses with a flag; the default is all tasks

full.why: brief: 'how many open tasks have it'

full.q: In what order does the `tags` command print the tags?

options.C: In the order the tags were first used

full.q: What must happen with todo.json files written by the current version, which have no tags in them?

options.A: The user is asked to confirm an upgrade the first time the file is opened
options.B: The user must run a one-off migration command first
options.C: They are rejected with an error asking the user to start a new file
options.D: They keep working as they are, with no migration step

full.why: brief: 'have to keep working as they are, no migration step'

full.q: How does `--all` on `list` behave together with `--tag`?

options.A: `--tag` wins and done tasks stay hidden
options.C: They cannot be combined; it is an error
options.D: Both apply: open and done tasks that have the tag(s) are shown

full.why: brief: '--all should still work together with it'

full.q: What does the text say about renaming tags, or removing a tag from an existing task?

options.A: Both are part of this change
options.B: Removing a tag is part of this change; renaming is not
options.C: Renaming a tag is part of this change; removing is not
options.D: Both are explicitly not part of this change

options.C: Tags on tasks, and listing tasks by tag

skim.q: According to this opening, what existing thing must keep working?

options.D: todo.json files written by the current version, without a migration

skim.q: How does a user reach the new behaviour?

options.B: A `--tag` option on `add` and `list` (and a `tags` command)
